justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/model/bytecode/UncommonTrap.java and core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/model/bytecode/BytecodeAnnotationBuilder.java. UncommonTrap is a small data/parser class with 4 fields, 1 constructor, 1 static parse method, and 1 toString, and it only depends on Tag, Map, and JITWatchConstants. Repo-wide search found only one production use, BytecodeAnnotationBuilder.visitTagUncommonTrap(), invoked from TAG_UNCOMMON_TRAP handling, so the class has neither high fan-in nor high fan-out evidence of a hub-like modularization smell.
